aboutGame.title: What is Home Alone Anomalies?
paragraphs: Home Alone Anomalies is a first-person horror observation game on Roblox built around one punishing question: has this room changed since you last looked? You are alone in a large suburban house, the doors are locked, and visitors keep arriving — some of them subtly wrong. Instead of fighting monsters, you compare every detail against the baseline you memorized at the start of the night.

A run follows the same rhythm every time. You sweep the house for object swaps, lighting shifts, duplicated furniture, and sound cues, then commit to an answer before the next knock. Let the wrong visitor in, or report an anomaly that is not there, and the night resets. Our wiki covers every system with room-by-room checklists, visitor profiles, a full walkthrough, and ending guides.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Home Alone Anomalies.

items.question: What is Home Alone Anomalies?
items.answer: Home Alone Anomalies is a first-person horror observation game on Roblox. You are alone in a large house, visitors keep arriving, and your job is to compare every room against the baseline you memorized at the start of the night. Report correctly and the night continues; let the wrong visitor in or miss a change and the run resets.

items.question: How do I start playing Home Alone Anomalies?
items.answer: Load into the house, walk one full lap without touching anything, and memorize the normal state of each room. Learn the default controls — move, look, interact, sprint, crouch, flashlight, and the journal — then begin your first night.

items.question: Who should I let in in Home Alone Anomalies?
items.answer: Check the cameras, observe the visitor through a window, and listen to what they say. If they need help, open the door; if something is off, turn off the porch light and do not let them in.

items.question: Are there codes in Home Alone Anomalies?
items.answer: There are no public Home Alone Anomalies codes documented right now. Any official codes would be announced by the developers, but none are currently listed on the official Roblox page.

items.question: How many endings does Home Alone Anomalies have?
items.answer: Home Alone Anomalies has multiple endings, including numbered outcomes and a secret ending that unlocks through specific choices during a run. Our endings hub breaks down the trigger for each one.

items.question: Can you play Home Alone Anomalies with friends?
items.answer: Yes. Home Alone Anomalies supports co-op with up to 18 players per server. Use voice chat to share what you find and split the house into zones.
